facts.quote:

on the nectar of several species of Rosaceae, several species of Asteraceae, and Heracleum sphondylium nectar; they also feed on other insects.

facts.text: Larvy jsou masožravé a žijí ve vlhké půdě a v listovém opadu.
facts.quote: E. livida larvae are also carnivorous and live in damp soil and leaf litter.
